notes: Crédit Mutuel (and CIC on the same platform) "Télécharger" CSV: one header row, semicolon-separated, unquoted, dd/mm/yyyy operation and value dates, debits as negative figures in "Débit" and credits positive in "Crédit" (comma decimal), the label, and "Solde" the balance after the line. ISO-8859-15 (é in the header), CRLF assumed, oldest first assumed, no thousands mark assumed. No currency is written. Closing = the last line's balance; opening = the first line's balance minus its amount. File name invented.
